faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild engines for all BMW M3 generations?
faqLeft.a: Yes — we rebuild and replace engines across every M3 generation, from the E46's S54 through the E9x's S65, the F80's S55, up to the current G80's S58.

faqLeft.q: Do I keep my original engine, or do you send me a different one?
faqLeft.a: We rebuild the engine your car already has wherever possible, avoiding the compatibility risks that come with fitting a used engine of unknown history.
Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqLeft.q: What warranty comes with a rebuild?
faqLeft.a: Every rebuild comes with a 12 month unlimited-mileage warranty.

faqRight.a: We collect your car nationwide from £70. Most vehicles are recovered within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: How much does a BMW M3 engine rebuild cost?
faqRight.a: Rebuilds start from £5,500 across all generations. Exact price depends on engine code and condition — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqRight.q: Is the crank hub issue the same as the rod bearing issue?
faqRight.a: No — they're different problems on different engines. The F80's S55 has a press-fit crank hub that can slip under hard use; the earlier E9x M3's S65 V8 has a separate, well-documented rod bearing wear pattern. We know the difference and address each accordingly.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
